warrior.name: Warbringer
warrior.desc: Twin blades: fast, relentless swings and Mortal Strike. Execute finishes low-health targets, and Hamstring and Intimidating Shout keep them in reach.

warrior.name: Rampager
warrior.desc: A greatsword: slow, heavy blows and Bloodthirst. Recklessness opens a damage window, and Enraged Regeneration heals you back.

warrior.name: Bulwark
warrior.desc: A halberd: strikes from 5 yards out, plus Concussion Blow and Fortress Stance. Tough and hard to kill, but deals less damage.

mage.name: Cryomancy
mage.desc: Slows and roots keep enemies away. Frost Nova and Deep Freeze apply Shatter, making your next frost damage hit five times as hard. Ice Barrier absorbs a burst.

mage.name: Pyromancy
mage.desc: Big fire damage: Pyroblast, instant Fireball and Scorch, and Flamestrike on the ground. Fragile.

mage.name: Starweaving
mage.desc: Strong mana regeneration and a damage cooldown. Arcane Missiles channel a volley (stand still to finish it), Arcane Barrage is a quick heavy hit and Arcane Explosion slows what is close.

priest.name: Warden
priest.desc: Wards and Pain Suppression keep allies alive, and Penance heals a friend or hurts a foe. Good all-round control.

priest.name: Lightbearer
priest.desc: The strongest direct healing and mana regeneration. Holy Nova heals your whole team and hurts every enemy in sight. Low damage.

priest.name: Gloomweaver
priest.desc: Rot and Shadow Word: Pain wear enemies down over time, Mind Flay channels damage, Mind Blast hits hard. Weaker healing.

rogue.name: Cutthroat
rogue.desc: Stealth openers into heavy hits. Mutilate leaves a bleed, Garrote is a deep instant bleed, and Exsanguinate cashes in your combo points on every bleed on the target.

rogue.name: Duelist
rogue.desc: Steady damage with Sinister Strike and Sprint for pressure. Adrenaline Rush spends combo points for faster swings, more energy and healing; Evasion keeps you alive.

rogue.name: Shade
rogue.desc: Slippery: Shadowstep (now worth 3 combo points) and Sprint for repositioning. Backstab hits twice as hard from behind the target and builds combo points; Eviscerate spends them for big instant damage.
